plugins.title: 表情包发送器
plugins.author: untarz
plugins.description: 基于插件v2协议开发的表情包发送器，支持本地表情包资源的打包、分类索引构建、回复装饰以及/表情管理命令的暴露。
plugins.entrySummary: 让bot能发送表情包，支持流式兼容和发送行为自定义

versions.changelog: Initial Android Native plugin market release.
修复概率出现的标签无法消除问题

plugins.title: QQ群聊消息分析
plugins.author: untarz
plugins.description: 手动触发的当前群聊消息分析插件，读取当前会话最近最多 100 条消息，生成基础统计、热门话题、群聊金句、用户风格和聊天质量报告。
plugins.entrySummary: 在当前群使用 /群分析-帮助，基于最近消息生成群聊分析。

permissions.title: Read current conversation history
permissions.description: Allows the plugin to read recent messages from the current conversation for manual analysis.

permissions.title: Read available LLM providers
permissions.description: Allows the plugin to select a configured provider and model when settings are not specified.

permissions.title: Send current conversation messages
permissions.description: Allows the plugin to send analysis results to the current conversation.

permissions.title: Call LLM
permissions.description: Allows the plugin to call the configured LLM to generate analysis reports.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Add manual current-conversation group analysis commands and history diagnostics. Require ElymBot host v1.1.1 or newer.
